description: React frontend for the AI Code Assistant Platform.

x-learning-notes.why-this-file-has-metadata-instead-of-co: package.json must remain valid JSON, so educational notes are stored in a safe custom metadata field.
x-learning-notes.production-analogy: In a real company this file is the contract between your application source and the JavaScript toolchain that builds and ships it.
x-learning-notes.architectural-reasoning: The frontend depends only on UI libraries and build tooling because orchestration and AI logic intentionally live in backend services.
